scope.provenance_note: Namespace ownership/access is not treated as proof of original authorship. README evidence is used where available; known forks/upstream projects are classified as reference/upstream.

doctrine: Every accessible juv4uk repository is accounted for exactly once.
Repository presence, implementation language, or installation never mints Core semantics.
Only CORE-LANGUAGE-DONOR and CORE-HISTORICAL-DONOR may directly enter missing-semantic review.
BACKEND-OR-MECHANISM repositories may contribute only independently proved universal seam/bridge/capability laws.
PACKAGE-OR-DOMAIN repositories retain native semantics; generic laws must be factored and re-owned before Core review.
Every proposed D10 semantic still requires exact D1-D9 duplicate, ownership, language-visible distinction, and mechanism-only checks.
